env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# A checked-source write into a const slice fails statically with the rule ID, before native code or eject.
cd m
cp ../checked.lgo main.lgo
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/wchecked$GOEXE .
stderr -count=7 '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
! logos eject -o $WORK/wchecked-out
stderr -count=7 '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'

# A store that bypasses checked-source enforcement faults at run time, because constant data with pointers lives in read-only memory.
cp ../forged.lgo main.lgo
logos build -o $WORK/bin/wfault$GOEXE .
! exec $WORK/bin/wfault$GOEXE store
stderr 'unexpected fault address'
! exec $WORK/bin/wfault$GOEXE increment
stderr 'unexpected fault address'
! exec $WORK/bin/wfault$GOEXE copy
stderr 'unexpected fault address'
! exec $WORK/bin/wfault$GOEXE copy-reslice
stderr 'unexpected fault address'
! exec $WORK/bin/wfault$GOEXE clear
stderr 'unexpected fault address'
! exec $WORK/bin/wfault$GOEXE store-nested
stderr 'unexpected fault address'

# An append to the full storage allocates a new array and leaves the constant alone.
exec $WORK/bin/wfault$GOEXE append
stdout '^append \[1 2 3 4\] \[1 2 3\]$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/wfault

go 1.27

-- checked.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type row struct {
	N int
	V []int
}

const L = []int{1, 2, 3}

const R = []row{{N: 1, V: []int{4, 5}}}

func main() {
	L[0] = 9
	L[1]++
	copy(L, []int{7})
	copy(L[1:], []int{7})
	clear(L)
	R[0].V[0] = 9
	s := append(L, 4)
	fmt.Println(s, L, R)
}
-- forged.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"unsafe"
)

type row struct {
	N int
	V []int
}

const L = []int{1, 2, 3}

const R = []row{{N: 1, V: []int{4, 5}}}

func forged(addr string, n int) []int {
	p, err := strconv.ParseUint(addr[2:], 16, 64)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return unsafe.Slice((*int)(unsafe.Pointer(uintptr(p))), n)
}

func main() {
	f := forged(fmt.Sprintf("%p", L), len(L))
	switch os.Args[1] {
	case "store":
		f[0] = 9
	case "increment":
		f[1]++
	case "copy":
		copy(f, []int{7})
	case "copy-reslice":
		copy(f[1:], []int{7})
	case "clear":
		clear(f)
	case "store-nested":
		forged(fmt.Sprintf("%p", R[0].V), len(R[0].V))[0] = 9
	case "append":
		s := append(f, 4)
		fmt.Println("append", s, L)
	}
	fmt.Println("no fault", L, R)
}
